end.summary:
• Identified triangles and polygons in different positions and sizes.
• Described triangles by equal sides and by right, acute, and obtuse angles.
• Named polygons by side count: triangle, quadrilateral, pentagon, hexagon, and octagon.
• Explained that polygons have straight, closed sides; side lengths need not be equal.
• Teach-back was not passed; Veer asked to play a game at the end.
end.parentNote: Veer practised recognising and naming triangles and polygons, including shapes in different positions. They used the method of checking for straight, closed sides and counting sides, and correctly distinguished a hexagon from a regular hexagon. Veer also described an equilateral triangle and a right-angled isosceles triangle; no misconceptions were recorded. At home, ask Veer to find and name five polygons around the house by counting their straight sides.
